lines.en: scene summervacation6 with flash
: Is this {i}really{/i} how you’re going to treat the {i}STAR?!{/i} I asked for a double short, low-fat, no foam latte and this is CLEARLY a double short, {i}non-{/i}fat, {i}low{/i} foam latte!
lines.zh: : 你{i}真的{/i}要这么对待本{i}明星{/i}吗？！我要的是双倍浓缩、低脂、无奶泡的拿铁，而这杯明显是双倍浓缩、{i}脱{/i}脂、{i}少{/i}奶泡的拿铁！

lines.en: scene summervacation13 with flash
: Your role is larger, but the direction of the character needs to stay the same or we’ll compromise the integrity of-
lines.zh: : 你的戏份更多了，但角色方向必须保持一致，否则会损害作品的完整性——

lines.en: : Nagasawa, let her speak. Miss Yasui is the only member of the cast who won an Academy Award, so we should, at the very least, hear her out.
lines.zh: : Nagasawa，让她说完。Yasui 小姐是剧组里唯一拿过奥斯卡奖的人，所以至少我们该听她把话说完。

lines.en: scene summervacation23 with flash
: I’LL BE IN MY TRAILER! CRYING! BECAUSE I’M SAD!
lines.zh: : 我要回我的拖车里！哭！因为我好难过！

lines.en: : Snookums! No! Come back, my wolf! Howl at your moon once more!
lines.zh: : 小亲亲！不要！回来吧，我的狼！再对你的月亮嚎叫一次！

lines.en: scene summervacation28 with flash
: How’s Karin, by the way? I heard she didn’t renew her contract. You guys still keep in touch?
lines.zh: : 对了，Karin 怎么样？我听说她没续约。你们还有联系吗？

lines.en: : Occasionally. She did wind up feeling like an actual sister to me by the end of the story.
lines.zh: : 偶尔。故事结束时，她对我来说确实像个真正的姐姐。

lines.en: : It’s still so crazy to me that you guys looked so much alike despite not actually being related. Great job to the casting department, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得很不可思议——你们明明没有血缘关系，却长得那么像。看来选角部门干得不错。

lines.en: : What’s crazier to me is that you and Akira actually {i}are{/i} related despite not looking that way at all.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更不可思议的是，你和 Akira 其实{i}真的{/i}有血缘关系，却一点都不像。

lines.en: scene summervacation31 with flash
: ...and so I was like, “Obvy, bitch. And I know you {i}think{/i} you’re looksmaxing, but your drip is fucking dog water and, not gonna lie, it’s giving serious chad vibes.”
lines.zh: : ……然后我就说：「废话，贱人。我知道你{i}自以为{/i}在颜值最大化，可你的穿搭烂得跟狗喝的水一样，说真的，那股劲儿简直是在硬装型男。」

lines.en: scene summervacation37 with flash
: Something something merch sale. Shirts like mine are only $10 from March 1, 2026 to March 31, 2026 at shop.selebus.com.
lines.zh: : 什么什么周边促销。像我这件一样的衬衫，2026 年 3 月 1 日至 3 月 31 日在 shop.selebus.com 只要 10 美元。

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo1 with flash
: Which brings us right back to where we left off last time! With the fate of the Tsukioka Foundation and two very lovely girls hanging in the balance!
lines.zh: : 这就让我们又回到了上次中断的地方！Tsukioka 财团的命运，还有两个非常可爱的女孩，全都悬而未决！

lines.en: : She’s talking about us.
lines.zh: : 她在说我们。

lines.en: : She’s very clearly {i}not{/i} talking about us since no one in their right mind would ever use the word “lovely” to describe you, whore.
lines.zh: : 她很明显{i}不是{/i}在说我们，因为脑子正常的人绝不会用「可爱」来形容你，骚货。

lines.en: : Sounds like something a loser would say.
lines.zh: : 听起来像是输家会说的话。

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo2
: Ha! How many polls have the two of us been in together now? And how many of them have you won, Noriko?! That’s right! None!
lines.zh: : 哈！我们俩到现在一起参加过多少次投票了？而你赢过几次，Noriko？！没错！一次都没有！

lines.en: : Sure. But this time is different.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过这次不一样。

lines.en: : I found a {i}loophole.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我找到了一个{i}漏洞{/i}。

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo3
: You what?
lines.zh: : 你什么？

lines.en: : You see, there’s this promotion going on right now with Fanfest 26 that gives all lifetime subscribers for Lessons in Love the chance to have their own custom animation made.
lines.zh: : 你看，Fanfest 26 现在有个活动——所有《Lessons in Love》的终身订阅者，都有机会定制一段属于自己的动画。

lines.en: : Don’t remind me. I’m still pissed off about having to scissor you last year because of that.
lines.zh: : 别提醒我。去年因为那个，我被迫跟你磨镜，我现在还火大呢。

lines.en: : Which is all fine and good and all. But there’s actually one {i}other{/i} benefit that comes with being a lifetime subscriber.
lines.zh: : 这些都挺好。不过「终身订阅」其实还有{i}另外{/i}一个好处。

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo4
: {i}Sixteen{/i} times the voting power on all polls, Maya! Guess who dropped $20k USD to make sure she’d be able to fuck her brother on camera! {i}This{/i} girl! That’s who!
lines.zh: : 所有投票的权重是{i}十六{/i}倍，Maya！猜猜是谁砸了两万美元，就为了确保自己能在镜头前和她哥做爱！就是{i}本姑娘{/i}！没错！

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo5
: Th...There’s still no way that was enough to dethrone me! I’m the main character! {i}I’m{/i} the popular one! You never win anything! And there’s no way just voting for yourself would-
lines.zh: : 这……这还不足以把我拉下马！我才是主角！{i}我{/i}才是人气最高的那个！你从来没赢过任何东西！而且光是给自己投票怎么可能——

lines.en: : Actually, Noriko’s right.
lines.zh: : 事实上，Noriko 是对的。

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo6
: What?! No! No she isn’t! You’re lying!
lines.zh: : 什么？！不！她才不对！你在撒谎！

lines.en: : No, I have the score right here.
lines.zh: : 不，比分就在我这儿。

lines.en: : Maya has 225 votes to Noriko’s 264. Meaning that Noriko gets to star in our new film alongside Sensei. I mean Dad. I mean Akira. I mean whatever I’m supposed to call him at this point in time.
lines.zh: : Maya 225 票，Noriko 264 票。也就是说，Noriko 将和 Sensei 一起主演我们的新片。我是说爸爸。我是说 Akira。我是说到了这个时候我该叫他什么来着。

lines.en: : No! This can’t be! Of all the people to beat me, you’re telling me it’s {i}her?!{/i} Is there no rule against voting for yourself?! Let alone that many times?!
lines.zh: : 不！这不可能！所有人里赢我的，你告诉我是{i}她{/i}？！难道没有禁止给自己投票的规则吗？！更别说还投那么多次？！

lines.en: : It’s just like Wu-Tang Clan says, Maya. Cash rules everything around me. CREAM, get the money. Dollar, dollar bill, y’all.
lines.zh: : 就像 Wu-Tang Clan 唱的那样，Maya。金钱统治我身边的一切。CREAM，去搞钱。钞票啊钞票啊，各位。

lines.en: : It's been twenty-two long, hard years, I'm still strugglin'. Survival got me buggin', but I'm alive on arrival.
lines.zh: : 漫长艰难的二十二年过去，我仍在挣扎求生。生存让我焦虑，但我一到场就还活着。

lines.en: : I peep at the shape of the streets and stay awake to the ways of the world 'cause shit is deep. A man with a dream with plans to make cream-
lines.zh: : 我窥视着街头的轮廓，对世间的法则保持清醒，因为这破事深得很。一个有梦想、计划着赚大钱的男人——

lines.en: : Shut the fuck up and tell me this is all a dream!
lines.zh: : 他妈的给我闭嘴，然后告诉我这一切都是场梦！

lines.en: : Not just {i}any{/i} dream, Maya. {i}Your worst nightmare.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不只是{i}随便什么{/i}梦，Maya。{i}是你最可怕的噩梦。{/i}

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo7
: Onii-chan, guess what! I finally won something! Now the whole {i}world{/i} will get to watch us have sex instead of just everybody we know!
lines.zh: : 欧尼酱，你猜怎么着！我终于赢了一次！现在整个{i}世界{/i}都能看到我们做爱了，而不只是我们认识的人！

lines.en: : This can’t be fucking happening! I won’t stand for it!
lines.zh: : 这他妈怎么可能发生！我不会就这么算了！

lines.en: : Maya, it’s going to be okay. We’ll wrap up filming in a couple days and you can have Sensdadkira back again.
lines.zh: : Maya，会没事的。我们再过几天就拍完了，到时候 Sensdadkira 就又归你了。

lines.en: : Yeah, exactly. And besides, you can just hang out with Tyler in the meantime. You like him, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 对，就是这样。再说，这段时间你可以先和 Tyler 待着。你喜欢他吧？

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo8 with flash
: Only because he’s Akira’s cousin! I don’t like him enough to do porn with him!
lines.zh: : 只因为他是 Akira 的表弟！我还不至于喜欢到要和他拍色情片！

lines.en: : I don’t know if I believe you. You seemed really into it during that one arc in Chapter 5 where Akira went back in time and the only one who could save him was you.
lines.zh: : 我不太信。第五章那段 Akira 穿越回过去、唯一能救他的人是你的时候，你看上去可投入了。

lines.en: : That was for {i}art!{/i} Not porn!
lines.zh: : 那是为了{i}艺术{/i}！不是色情！

lines.en: : Either way! Sensei belongs to us now and you can’t have him. Sucks to suck! Do better in the next poll.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样！Sensei 现在归我们了，你别想要回去。活该！下次投票再加油吧。

lines.en: : GAH!
lines.zh: : GAH!

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo9 with flash
: Let’s go, Tyler! You’re coming with me!
lines.zh: : 走了，Tyler！你跟我来！

lines.en: : But I’m not done with my juice box yet! And labor laws say I’m only allowed to work in four hour increments or-
lines.zh: : 可我果汁还没喝完呢！而且劳动法规定我一次只能工作四个小时，或者——

lines.en: : Don’t fucking talk back to me, twerp! I have so much anger to get out right now and you’re the only possible way for me to do that!
lines.zh: : 别他妈跟我顶嘴，小屁孩！我现在有一肚子火要发泄，而你是唯一能让我发泄的办法！

lines.en: scene black
: N...Not agaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaain!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : N...Not agaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaain!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

scene summervacationtwo10 with flash
: So, Noriko won the poll for leading actress. I’m beginning to understand why Lessons in Love may have failed.
lines.zh: : 所以，Noriko 赢得了最佳女主角的投票。我开始明白《Lessons in Love》为什么会失败了。

lines.en: : I don’t think it was wrong to focus on Maya as the heroine for the bulk of Chapter 5, Miss Tsukioka. The entire story up to that point had been leading to-
lines.zh: : 我不认为第五章大部分篇幅以 Maya 为女主角是错的，Tsukioka 小姐。到那时为止的整个故事都在导向——

lines.en: : Frankly speaking, Nagasawa, I don’t have nearly the same level of trust in your judgement that I had when I signed onto this project.
lines.zh: : 坦白说，Nagasawa，我对你的判断力已经远不如我签下这个项目时那么信任了。

lines.en: : If the viewers want Noriko, we just need to give them Noriko. But what I struggle with now is understanding how {i}to{/i} give them Noriko.
lines.zh: : 如果观众想要 Noriko，我们就给他们 Noriko。可我现在纠结的是，到底该{i}怎么{/i}把 Noriko 给他们。

lines.en: : We’ve exhausted practically every single type of sex scene in the book with Lessons in Love. So what can we give viewers {i}now{/i} that they haven’t already seen?
lines.zh: : 《Lessons in Love》几乎已经把书上每一种性爱场面都用尽了。那我们{i}现在{/i}还能给观众什么他们没看过的东西？

lines.en: : I suppose we could-
lines.zh: : 我想我们可以——

lines.en: : Not you. I want Ami and Ayane to weigh in. Their suggestions actually {i}help.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不是你。我要 Ami 和 Ayane 发表意见。她们的建议才真的{i}有用{/i}。

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo11 with flash
: Ami and I talked about it amongst ourselves earlier, but we’d be fine joining in as actors again if you’re looking to spice things up.
lines.zh: : Ami 和我刚才私下聊过了，如果你想加点料，我们不介意再以演员身份加入。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m experienced enough when it comes to acting in sex scenes at this point that I should still be able to direct even if I’m in the middle of one.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我在性爱戏表演上的经验已经足够丰富，就算身在其中，应该也还能导演。

lines.en: : You two say this as if you were ever {i}acting{/i} in the first place. You refuse to even take a paycheck because, and I quote, “getting railed by Akira is the only payment a girl could ever need.”
lines.zh: : 你们俩说得好像自己当初真的在{i}演戏{/i}似的。你们连片酬都不肯拿，用你的原话说就是：「被 Akira 干就是女孩唯一需要的报酬。」

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo12
: I said what I said and I’ll never take it back.
lines.zh: : 我说过的话就是说过，我绝不会收回。

lines.en: : With all due respect to both of you, I can’t imagine our viewers want to see any more sex scenes with either of you when you combined to make up roughly half of them in the entire first production.
lines.zh: : 恕我直言，你们俩在第一部作品里加起来占了差不多一半的性爱戏，我想观众大概不想再看你们的了。

lines.en: : That’s not fair. Like half of those were improv and improv scenes don’t count.
lines.zh: : 这不公平。那些里面有一半是即兴的，即兴的不算数。

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo13
: Well, what about expanding the universe? And bringing in one of those girls from that other production we axed before the ball ever got rolling?
lines.zh: : 那么，扩展一下世界观呢？把那个还没开始就被我们砍掉的作品里的某个女孩拉进来？

lines.en: : You mean “Grow Old. Then Die?”
lines.zh: : 你是说《变老。然后死去？》

lines.en: : Not possible, I’m afraid. Restrictions on fringe content are really ramping up and we’re enough of a target for censorship as-is.
lines.zh: : 恐怕不行。对边缘内容的限制正在急剧收紧，而我们本来就已经够招审查了。

lines.en: : Yes, unfortunately, this is one of the very few times Nagasawa has been right. And that’s not even factoring in how the actress who was supposed to play Izumi died of an overdose last year.
lines.zh: : 没错，很遗憾，这是 Nagasawa 为数不多说对的几次之一。而且这还没算上——原本要演 Izumi 的那个女演员去年因为吸毒过量死了。

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo14
: God rest her soul.
lines.zh: : 愿她的灵魂安息。

lines.en: : Perhaps it’s finally time to come up with answer to what the backwards spider crawl is? I’m sure we could bring back a sizable portion of our fans from the last production with the answer to such a burning question.
lines.zh: : 也许终于该给「倒着蜘蛛爬」一个答案了？我相信只要回答了这个迫切的问题，就能把上一部作品里相当一部分粉丝拉回来。

lines.en: : I’ll get in contact with Professor Kadowaki. I liked her work in choreographing a lot of the other positions we made up for Lessons in Love. Perhaps she can figure something out?
lines.zh: : 我会联系 Kadowaki 教授。我很喜欢她为《Lessons in Love》编排那些体位时的工作。也许她能想出什么办法？

lines.en: : I guess there’s always a dog too.
lines.zh: : 我想还可以加只狗。

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo15
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Ayane...you don’t mean...
lines.zh: : Ayane……你不是指……

lines.en: : Everybody loves dogs, Ami.
lines.zh: : 大家都喜欢狗啊，Ami。

lines.en: : I don’t think they love them {i}that{/i} much, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不觉得大家喜欢到{i}那种{/i}程度。

lines.en: : No, but Noriko might. And if she’s going to be the star-
lines.zh: : 是不会，但 Noriko 可能会。而且如果她是主演——

lines.en: : We’re not using any animals! I’m still drowning in fines from the horse scene we attempted three years ago. Just...figure something out!
lines.zh: : 我们不许用任何动物！三年前我们试过一场马的戏，那些罚款到现在还没交完。你们就……想个办法出来！

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo16
: Ask Arakawa himself if you need to! Just have the answer on my desk by the end of the night. I’d like to get rehearsals going as early as tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 需要的话就去问 Arakawa 本人！今晚结束前把答案放到我桌上。我想最迟明天就开始排练。

lines.en: : Is that really enough time? Won’t it take longer for Nodoka to revise the script?
lines.zh: : 时间真的够吗？Nodoka 改剧本不是要更久吗？

lines.en: : The woes of being a writer never end, do they? Arakawa’s in his room if you want to talk to him. I’ll be drowning my sorrows at the bar in the meantime. I can’t think right now.
lines.zh: : 当编剧的苦日子是没完没了的，对吧？想找 Arakawa 的话，他在自己房间里。我先去酒吧借酒消愁了。我现在没法思考。

lines.en: : So just...figure out a way to make this production more exciting and report back to you, Touka?
lines.zh: : 也就是说……想办法让这部作品更带劲，然后向你汇报，Touka？

lines.en: : Right. It’s either that or I’ll need to dig deeper into the bank for more funding to pay Yasu in hopes that she can salvage everything. She’s charging extra for nude scenes now.
lines.zh: : 对。要么这样，要么我就得再从银行里挖出更多资金来付给 Yasu，指望她能力挽狂澜。她现在演裸戏还要加钱了。

lines.en: : It was only a matter of time. She’s always been way too good for us.
lines.zh: : 那只是时间问题。她对我们来说一直都太屈才了。

lines.en: : I wonder if an orgy’s on the table? I’m kind of surprised we never had one in Lessons in Love. They look fun.
lines.zh: : 我想知道能不能搞个群交？我们《Lessons in Love》里居然一次都没有，我还挺意外的。看起来挺好玩的。

lines.en: : Arakawa gets “overwhelmed” when there are more than three girls present in a sex scene. But if the two of you can convince him...
lines.zh: : 性爱戏里只要超过三个女孩，Arakawa 就会「招架不住」。不过要是你们俩能说服他……

lines.en: : Oh, if anyone can convince him, it’s us.
lines.zh: : 哦，要说谁能说服他，那就是我们了。

scene summervacationtwo17 with flash
: Sensei! We were just wondering if- oh.
lines.zh: : Sensei！我们正想问你——哦。

lines.en: : EYAHAEHAHAHEAHEHAHEHAYAEHHAHHHUUUUUUUUUUUUUUHH!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : EYAHAEHAHAHEAHEHAHEHAYAEHHAHHHUUUUUUUUUUUUUUHH!!!!!!!!

lines.en: : No wonder she’s so self-conscious about the noises she makes during sex.
lines.zh: : 难怪她对自己做爱时发出的声音那么在意。

lines.en: scene summervacationtwo18
: Intruders! What are you doing here?! Did you not hear the sex music?!?! Can’t you see I’m trying to get my FREAK ON??!?!?!?!?!! With my WIFE!?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 入侵者！你们在这儿干什么？！你们没听见性爱音乐吗？！？！没看见我正在发──疯──大──干──吗？？！？！？！？！？！跟我的老──婆！？！？！？！

lines.en: : And his sister. Hi. What’s up? Do you guys need something? We have like five whole pizzas you can help yourself to if you’re hungry.
lines.zh: : 还有他妹妹。嗨。怎么了？你们有事吗？我们这儿有差不多五整块披萨，饿了尽管自己拿。

lines.en: : Just to test the waters here — Sensei! Do you mind if Ami and I join in as well?
lines.zh: : 先探探口风——Sensei！你介意我和 Ami 也加入吗？

lines.en: : What?! Are you SERIOUS?! You know how overwhelmed I get when there are more than three girls present for a sex scene! Didn’t you read my contract?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！你是认真的吗？！你知道性爱戏里超过三个女孩我会多招架不住！你没看我的合同吗？！

lines.en: : Fine, fine. I guess Ayane will just have to wait outside then.
lines.zh: : 好好好。那我看 Ayane 就只能在外面等着了。

lines.en: : Noriko, just out of curiosity, how do you feel about dogs?
lines.zh: : Noriko，出于好奇问一下，你觉得狗怎么样？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : Okay. Well, that answers that question.
